interfaces.name: get-page
interfaces.description: Serves public/index.html with status 200 and Content-Type text/html.

errors.when: a method other than GET or HEAD

interfaces.name: get-static
interfaces.description: Serves a file under public/ with a Content-Type by extension (.html, .css, .mjs/.js as text/javascript, .json, .svg, .ico); nothing outside public/.

errors.when: the file does not exist or the path escapes public/
a method other than GET or HEAD

interfaces.name: start
interfaces.description: Starts the server on the PORT environment variable, default 8080.

interfaces.name: validateLength
interfaces.description: validateLength(raw) and validateQuantity(raw): return { ok: true, value } for a finite number > 0 (quantity: integer >= 1), else { ok: false, message }. Used for blade width, board and piece lengths and quantities.

interfaces.name: computeLayout
interfaces.description: computeLayout(plan): places piece instances (manual placements first, then first-fit decreasing), applies the kerf rule of ADR-002 and returns per-board segments (piece, kerf, offcut) summing to each board's length, plus unplaced instances with a TOO_LONG or NO_ROOM reason and a sentence in mm.

interfaces.name: checkMove
interfaces.description: checkMove(plan, layout, instanceId, boardId): whether the instance fits the target board's current pieces excluding itself; applyMove(plan, instanceId, boardId) returns a new plan with placements[instanceId] = boardId.

errors.when: the piece plus one kerf does not fit the space left on the target board; the message gives piece length, kerf and space left in mm
the instance or board does not exist

interfaces.name: plan-edits
interfaces.description: emptyPlan(), addBoard, updateBoard, removeBoard, addPiece, updatePiece, removePiece, setBlade: pure functions returning a new plan; removing a board or lowering a quantity drops placements that no longer apply.

interfaces.name: saved-plan
interfaces.description: One JSON value in the shape of spec §9: { version: 1, bladeMm, boards[{id,lengthMm}], pieces[{id,lengthMm,quantity,label}], placements{instanceId: boardId} }.

interfaces.name: loadPlan
interfaces.description: loadPlan(storage = localStorage): the saved plan, or the empty plan when missing, unparsable or malformed; never throws. savePlan(plan, storage) writes it; clearPlan(storage) removes it. Storage exceptions are caught and reported as { ok: false }.

errors.when: localStorage throws on read or write; the plan still works in memory

interfaces.name: planner-page
interfaces.description: The single page: blade width, boards and pieces forms and lists, layout bars, unplaced panel with add-board, move controls, clear-plan, print cut sheet, and a hidden cut-sheet section shown by the print stylesheet. Elements carry data-board-id, data-kind, data-length-mm and data-instance-id for checks.

interfaces.name: run-tests
interfaces.description: Unit tests of planner-core and plan-store and a smoke test of static-server, Node built-ins only.
